$comment: Machine-readable Sprint 2 plan. Prose rationale lives in specs/sprint-2-charter.md; this file is the shape delivery_loop_gate.py consumes. Verify with: delivery_loop_gate.py --plan specs/sprint-2-loop-plan.json --mode plan. Every task carries acceptance.cmd rather than acceptance.criterion -- with a single human, owner == reviewer, and machine verification is what makes that non-circular (charter section 4).
goal: Make every doc claim about state match the system that owns it, and automate the sync check that catches the next drift. PLZG Sprint 2, board 169, sprint 44, 2026-07-30 to 2026-08-13.

tasks.title: Reconcile the checkout against origin/dev before any other task (EXEMPT from the attempt cap; blocks every task below)

acceptance.cmd: git fetch origin && test "$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/dev)" -eq 0

tasks.title: PLZG-115 -- register the three unregistered reference docs so validate_specs.py exits 0
PLZG-114 -- SessionStart hook plus scripts/check_sync.sh enforcing the environment sync, with a --strict mode CI can consume

acceptance.cmd: test -x scripts/check_sync.sh && scripts/check_sync.sh && python3 -c "import json,sys; h=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json')).get('hooks',{}); sys.exit(0 if 'SessionStart' in h else 1)"

tasks.title: PLZG-110 -- QUICKSTART .env template must carry ATLASSIAN_JIRA_PROJECT_KEY and drop the stale KeyError claim, since generate_report.py now exits 1 via a guard

acceptance.cmd: grep -q 'ATLASSIAN_JIRA_PROJECT_KEY' QUICKSTART.md && ! grep -q 'crash with a `KeyError`' QUICKSTART.md

tasks.title: PLZG-108 -- QUICKSTART must not cast doubt on whether the Godot prototype exists; CLAUDE.md and task-tracker.md are the status of record
PLZG-109 -- resolve the Confluence coordinate split: QUICKSTART placeholders vs the parent_page_id post_to_confluence.py publishes. Cite DELIVERY-COORDINATES rather than restating ids.

acceptance.cmd: ! grep -q 'Your Confluence Home Page goes Here' QUICKSTART.md && grep -q 'delivery-coordinates' QUICKSTART.md

tasks.title: PLZG-111 and PLZG-112 -- strike the stale 'TO-127 to TO-136 still need triage' claim from CHANGELOG.md and docs/delivery-coordinates.md; they were closed 2026-07-29 and exist as PLZG-104 to PLZG-113
PLZG-106 -- CHANGELOG [Unreleased] must name one board for generate_report.py, consistent with the script reading ATLASSIAN_JIRA_PROJECT_KEY
PLZG-107 -- bring CLAUDE.md back within META-SPEC section 6's ~200-line instruction budget by splitting, not by deleting the sync section

acceptance.cmd: test "$(wc -l < CLAUDE.md)" -le 200 && grep -q 'Sync the environment before anything else' CLAUDE.md
